references.text: Contains the same law that those who are afraid may return home from war, which Gideon applies here
Moses' law about who should be exempted from military service, including those who were afraid and discouraged
Gideon's army of 10,000 men remaining is mentioned again in the same context
Describes the size of the Midianite army that Gideon fought against with his reduced force
David said that no one should lose heart because of the enemy, a similar theme about fear in war
The psalmist declares that he will not be afraid even if an army camps against him
